bullets.text: In Uthukottai, heavy rains submerged 400 acres of paddy fields, requiring the district team to assess agricultural losses and relief measures.
The IMD issued heavy rain red and orange alerts across multiple districts, urging the office to coordinate disaster response readiness.
Heavy rain caused severe potholes on Velachery Road, and the constituency team should monitor pothole repairs and traffic management.
A buffalo died after getting stuck in the Pallikaranai marshland, and local officials are working to clear the area safely.
Residents flagged safety risks as silt removed from canals piled up along city roads, prompting the team to monitor debris clearance.
Agricultural officers inspected rain-affected paddy fields in Ponneri and Minjur, advising farmers to use farm ponds for rainwater harvesting.
Karukku Old Road in Ambattur faced severe waterlogging for the second consecutive year, requiring local drainage intervention.
Officials inspected the Rs 4,800 crore Minjur desalination plant project to help secure drinking water supplies for North Chennai.
Tamil Nadu is developing the AI-enabled e-Sevai 2.0 platform to integrate up to 1,000 government services under one roof.
CapitaLand Investment launched a 53 MW data centre project in Chennai, strengthening regional digital infrastructure capabilities.
IT Secretary Atul Anand reported that security vulnerabilities in 10 government PHP websites have been successfully patched.
PMK leader Ramadoss urged the government to immediately drop efforts to privatize registration and land surveying services.
TVK district secretaries and officials met the mother of a missing seven-year-old girl in Gingee to offer their condolences.
